digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and integration performance
propositions: Large partial-clone fixtures (>100MiB) are duplicated per xdist worker, contributing 32.69s to integration census; feasibility of splitting into one retained large guard and isolated small protocol-only fixtures with no cross-worker mutable state.

Small real Git server fixtures (1 KiB) are size-independent for protocol negotiation, missing-object, identity, and reconvergence test cases but require exact-defect mutation proof that failure oracle does not depend on repository size.

Maintained OSS projects (git/git, jelmer/dulwich, eclipse-jgit/jgit) use ephemeral per-test loopback daemons with explicit teardown and distinct ports for parallel workers; no consensus on shared mutable servers across concurrent workers.

Prototype validation achieved 69.5% pytest wall-time reduction (78.85s to 24.06s) and 85.2% setup-time savings by moving 7 size-independent cases to isolated small fixtures while retaining 141 MiB pack guard in confined xdist group.

Exact-defect mutation (replacing 1 KiB payload with 141 MiB) caused pack-oracle failure at 144432 KiB, proving small fixtures have independent failure detection for negotiation, missing-object, and protocol cases.

No production Git protocol behavior or external protocol coverage replaced by mocks; retained guards use real Git protocol with incompressible >140 MiB contrast; each worker owns separate temporary repositories, object databases, ephemeral ports, and daemons.
